notes.title: Nightmare Update COMING TO STEAM!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Crime Scene Cleaner launches its first major update “Nightmare Update” July 24, 2025 on Steam![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The nightmares are getting worse. From twisted spaces to blood-soaked rooms, each scene feels like a descent into madness. It's your job to erase every trace – no matter how disturbing...[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yQZKS9_JpBI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]A big update is coming your way - available on Steam[/b] [b]24th July 2025[/b]. The Challenge Mode “Nightmare” update will contain [b]whole 10 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map[/b], featuring [b]new mechanics[/b] and even more thrilling gameplay. Completing these special nightmare maps will reward you with [b]unlockable cosmetics[/b] – special skins – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge![/p][p][/p][p]Cleaning up after the mafia was never going to be without consequences. Nothing is as it was – and he’ll have to face them all over again.[/p][p][/p][p]Think you’ve mastered the art of cleaning? Think again. notes.title: Get Ready for the Nightmare Update – Join the Beta!
notes.notes:
[p]Sup Cleaners!

You’ve voiced your thoughts and many of you expressed a willingness to help us test new content. And we want to make our community feel special! Let it be a thank-you gift for our most engaged players for waiting so long. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/3b1ad18036ca2993054796846cbc9d73576d16ce.png"][/img]
We know that you’re tired of waiting. And let me tell you… it’s about time. [b]Nightmare [/b]Update is slowly coming to Crime Scene Cleaner! Now you can grab the [b]beta access code[/b] from the news section on our discord server and [b]join the Nightmare Update tests[/b] starting [b]NOW[/b]. Help us find all the bugs and other issues! Your feedback will be invaluable.

The Nightmare Update is our[b] first big update[/b] with new content – and [b]we’re opening up a beta test[/b] for players who want to experience it first.

The update introduces [b]new challenge modes[/b]. Nightmare mode contains whole [b]10 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map[/b], featuring [b]new mechanics[/b] and even more thrilling gameplay. Completing these special nightmare maps will reward you with unlockable cosmetics – [b]special skins[/b] – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge!

[b]How to join Crime Scene Cleaner "Nightmare Update" beta test?[/b] Hop on our [b]discord[/b], the [b]inivitation link is attached to the image below[/b]! That's where you'll find the code and all the important instructions you need.

Be among the first to face the nightmare![/p][h3]
Edit: Beta has ended.
  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png"][/img]

[/h3]

notes.title: Roadmap Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello Cleaners!

We’re hard at work tackling the points on our [b]roadmap[/b]. While it’s taking some time, rest assured we’re making [b]steady progress[/b] on both the [b]Challenge Modes update [/b]and the [b]upcoming new acts[/b]. That’s why you don’t have to worry, that you will have to wait so much for the next update once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/92954e4e792376d9dffe4709bb87669b81217deb.png[/img]

[h2]NIGHTMARE MAPS[/h2]
What started as a small addition with Challenge Modes has grown into something much bigger than expected. During development, [b]we decided to take this update to the next level [/b]and make 10 new maps based on the ones you already know from the main campaign. As a result, the Challenge Modes update will now include 1[b]0 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map[/b], featuring [b]new mechanics[/b] and even more thrilling gameplay. Each mission that Kovalsky has taken on has left its mark on him, and now you’ll have the chance to delve into his deepest nightmares. These maps uncover the darkest corners of his mind, reimagining familiar crime scenes as [b]twisted versions[/b] of themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/69170a2d8fe058f81b1f55211dc926cb1a33064d.gif[/img]

[h2]REWARDS[/h2]
Completing these special nightmare maps will [b]reward [/b]you with [b]unlockable cosmetics[/b] – special skins – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge. These maps aren’t just harder versions of familiar levels. Prepare for new scenarios, new crime scenes, old but new locations with an exciting twist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/e26d068d6eafd7522d62675106f80129ae31c232.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/b5730e2d19c9d12e489a8f5ee6986546324b4c7e.png[/img]
[h2]COMMUNITY VOTED MAP[/h2]
But that’s not all! As promised, we’re also working on something very special: a brand-new mission [b]“Underground Lab”[/b] inspired by the [b]winner of our community contest[/b] on Discord! This mission, designed with input from our amazing fan, is about to become real. Maybe later the winner will share with us how it feels to see his own idea in Crime Scene Cleaner?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/76ae31635a75c33ebe7d065c9c9ab9adb75e2206.gif[/img]

Thank you for your patience and stay tuned for more updates, more crime scenes and more content. And how many cool cosmetics did you find hidden in this post? Let us know!

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]

notes.title: Post-Launch Free Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Sup Cleaners!

Thank you for your incredible support and enthusiasm since the launch of Crime Scene Cleaner! We are so glad for such a warm reception of a game in which we poured our heart and time into. But it’s not the end of our journey and expect more content coming. We're excited to share with you our post-launch roadmap, which outlines the upcoming updates and content you can look forward to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/4459221c10e84af02b05a0e5514fbb9b9b1eaf66.png[/img]

[h2]Phase 1: Hotfixes & QoL[/h2]
Our first priority is to address community feedback and fix common errors reported by our players. We're actively working on hotfixes and quality-of-life improvements to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

In this phase, we also invite you to report any translation errors you come across. We’re preparing to support community-created translations, so your input will be invaluable in making Crime Scene Cleaner accessible to players around the world. At this moment we are working on traditional chinese translation, but we plan to add more languages (the most requested ones) into the game. So why don’t you push us in the right direction and [b]let us know in discord, if you need any different language to be added?[/b] In the case of not-so-well-known languages, you can contact us directly, because we know from experience that players who know the game are great and can help a lot with localization! 

[h2]Phase 2: Gameplay Update[/h2]
Once the initial fixes are in place, we'll shift our focus to expanding the gameplay experience. We're excited to introduce new [b]Challenge Modes[/b] that will allow you to replay existing missions with new and exciting modifiers. These modes are currently hidden under the "unavailable" tabs, but they will soon be unlocked and ready for you to tackle! Let us know if there are any modifiers you wish to see in these challenges.

[h2]Phase 3: Act II Part 1[/h2]
Finally, we'll be rolling out new content, starting with a [b]Community Voted Map[/b] — a location chosen in a contest a while ago by you, our players! The crime scene idea that won the contest is an Underground Lab, but who knows… there might be something else coming too? After that, get ready for the next chapter in the story with [b]Kovalsky's New Chapter[/b], as this is not the end!

[h2]Phase 4: Act II Part 2[/h2]
And lastly… that’s not the end because[b] Kovalsky's story continues[/b]! Expect thrilling new missions, more narrative elements, and more challenges as the story unfolds.
Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being a part of the Crime Scene Cleaner! Also, remember to join our discord, if you want to share your experiences with other cleaners like you.

[h2]CONCLUSION[/h2]
No worries, because the entire content from the update roadmap will be [b]a free addition to the full game[/b]! We want to expand the base game, so every update we’ve mentioned here will be available to all players who bought Crime Scene Cleaner at no additional cost. If you already own the game, you’ll be able to hop on Crime Scene Cleaner and experience all the new content without paying a cent more.

On a related note, we’re excited to announce that the [b]official soundtrack for Crime Scene Cleaner will be available for purchase on Steam starting August 27th[/b]! The soundtrack is a way to support our talented musicians who contributed to the game's immersive audio experience. If you’d like to show them some love, grabbing the soundtrack is a great way to do so.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153150/Crime_Scene_Cleaner_Soundtrack/

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being a part of the Crime Scene Cleaner! Also, remember to join our discord, if you want to share your experiences with other cleaners like you.

See ya soon!
[i]The Devs[/i]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/EjHuxvM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devblog #15 - The "Interior Designer" Update
notes.notes:
Hello Cleaners!
It’s renovation time! Proper cleanup does not only mean collecting trash or washing up floors and walls. Once the mayhem of a crime happens, there will be some furniture you must move around. These could be a sign of struggle or victims’ attempts to hide.  

At the beginning of some missions, you may receive photos which will guide you in cleaning up misplaced furniture. Miscellaneous things should be returned to their spots, so no one can even suspect that anything has happened before. Sometimes you will have to use your own imagination and cleaning sense to make sure everything is in the right spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/f0a26417f04ea2b88292ab181b7d6cf1005c3128.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/733fb6dc176cbfdb130e3353a3d7da5b3712448f.jpg[/img]

Luckily, you don’t have to worry about perfectly recreating the pictures, coherent look is key. If you find random chairs in the middle of the room, make sure to find which table has an unfinished set. The same goes for other larger objects such as drawers or wardrobes. Every cabinet has to have a full set of drawers and stand in roughly the same place. So before you move on to another room, make sure everything is neat and as clean as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/50acd87a26aaae9644fb7af0bbd52ae3b330f0c5.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, not every piece of furniture can be simply picked up and placed in its rightful spot. There are those which are too big to simply throw away, in that case, you will be forced to dismantle them into smaller pieces, so they can fit in your van more easily. Luckily you have your powerful fists! Break the old furniture to make space for potentially new! The house owner will thank you later! If they are still alive that is... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/145aeefb3539e62b417d771bc2c7cd01db0b306e.gif[/img]

These small renovations may be some of the final things you do on the crime scene, so check every corner carefully before you leave. It would be unprofessional to leave the house you just spent time cleaning and renovating in a state of disarray. Hopefully, you enjoy a bit of house decor and macabre renovations. Let us know what you think about this element of cleaning up. We’re awaiting your feedback here in the comments, on our social media and in our discord.

See you next time!
[url=https://discord.gg/FXbMXtJpae][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]
